C0324.title: Microsoft Warns: OAuth Redirect Abuse Leads to Phishing and Malware Distribution
C0324.summary: In March 2026, Microsoft disclosed phishing and malware campaigns abusing OAuth's standard redirection behavior. Attackers created applications with malicious redirect URIs and embedded OAuth URLs using parameters such as prompt=none and invalid scopes in emails, using trusted identity-provider error redirects to send victims to attacker-controlled pages; some campaigns then downloaded ZIP/LNK payloads and executed PowerShell and DLL side-loading.

references.title: OAuth redirection abuse enables phishing and malware delivery
